question: Who has the largest deposit market share in the Worcester, MA metro area?
headline: Bank of America Corp has the largest deposit market share in the Worcester, MA metro area, at 13.52% ($3.04B) as of June 30, 2026.
insights: Bank of America Corp ranks first with 11 branches; UFS BCORP is second at 11.29% ($2.54B) with 14 branches, and Toronto-Dominion Bank The is third at 9.94%.

question: In which Massachusetts counties does Eastern Bankshares have its highest deposit market share?
headline: Eastern Bankshares' highest deposit market share in Massachusetts counties is in Plymouth County (17.89%, rank #2), followed by Essex (11.35%, rank #3) and Middlesex (5.87%, rank #5).
insights: As of June 30, 2026 (FDIC Summary of Deposits), Plymouth County has the highest share of any Massachusetts county where Eastern Bankshares operates, at 17.89%, and it ranks second behind a larger competitor.
Essex County is next at 11.35% (rank #3 of 31 organizations), and Middlesex County is third at 5.87% (rank #5 of 42).
Suffolk County has the largest dollar deposits ($9.37B) but only a 2.46% share, because the county's market is large (about $381B in total deposits) and includes many large and internet-based banks.
Shares are branch-booked deposits, so internet and custody banks with head-office deposits can inflate a county's totals.
